problem.title: Top K Frequent Elements
problem.problemStatement: Given an array of integers and an integer K, determine the K most frequently occurring elements. If multiple answers are possible, return any valid order.
problem.input: • First line contains integers N and K. • Second line contains N integers.
problem.output: Print the K most frequent elements.
